recipes.title: SHEET PAN PROTEIN PANCAKES
ingredients: 3 cups rolled oats, blended until smooth
directions: Preheat oven to 190°C (Fan forced).
In a blender, add milk, cottage cheese, maple syrup, apple sauce and vanilla. Blend for 30 seconds or until smooth.
In a large bowl, add the egg whites and whip them with a whisk until they become frothy.
In another large bowl, add the oat flour, powdered milk, baking soda, baking powder, and salt until everything is well incorporated.
Pour the contents of the blender into the egg whites and mix. Slowly whisk in the dry ingredients to form the batter.
Line a deep dish with baking paper. Pour in pancake batter into the centre of the dish and spread across the pan until it is even/
Bake for 20 minutes OR until it has set in the middle and is firm to touch.
When ready to eat, microwave the pancakes for 1-2 minutes until hot. Add fresh fruit for toppings. 4 servings 30 minutes

recipes.title: TIRAMISU BAKED OATS
ingredients: 60g protein powder (Recommend: Vanilla or salted caramel)
2 heaped teaspoons instant coffee + 60 ml boiling water
directions: Preheat oven to 180 °C fan forced.
Combine oats, bananas, protein powder, coffee, milk, baking powder, chia seeds and maple syrup in a square baking dish. Mix well to thoroughly combine the oat mixture.
Bake in the oven for 35minutes. Take out and leave to cool for 5minutes.
Cover fully the surface of the baked oats with the yoghurt using the back of a spoon or spatula until smooth.
Dust the yoghurt iced surface with cocoa powder.
Cut and divide into nine equal portions.
Store individual portions in air-tight containers and enjoy! 4 servings 45 minutes

recipes.title: PREP-AHEAD EGG MCMUFFINS
directions: Preheat oven to 180°C (Fan forced).
Whisk together eggs, milk, spinach and salt & pepper in a medium bowl.
Heat olive oil in a medium pan over medium heat. Add 4 egg rings and pour egg mixture into each. Cook for 3-5 minutes or until eggs are cooked all the way through. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Toast english muffins in your toaster.
Assemble egg McMuffins by placing 1 egg ring, 2 slices of ham, 1 slice of cheese and 1 tablespoon bbq sauce between the McMuffins.
Let the muffin cool before wrapping in foil or cling film. Store in the fridge for 4 days or in the freezer (in a freezer safe bag/container) for up to 3 months.
When ready to eat, take out of the freezer the night before and reheat in the microwave for 45-50 seconds. 4 muffins 25 minutes

recipes.title: TURKISH EGGS
directions: In a small saucepan over high heat, bring salted water to the boil. Once boiling, gently add eggs and boil for 7 minutes (The inside will still be slightly runny). Remove from the water and place into an ice water bath to prepare for peeling.
Meanwhile, combine yoghurt, garlic, lemon juice and dill in a small bowl. Mix until combined and season with salt and pepper to taste. Divide yoghurt between 2 containers (if preparing ahead).
Gently peel eggs and place on top of yoghurt (2 eggs in each container).
In a small bowl, combine olive oil with smoked paprika and chilli flakes. Mix to combine and then drizzle over the eggs.
Serve with 1 slice of freshly toasted sourdough bread. 2 servings 20 minutes

recipes.title: SMOOTHIE
ingredients: 1 banana, frozen into chunks or fresh
directions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. 1 servings 5 minutes

recipes.title: HIGH PROTEIN PORRIDGE
directions: Add oats, banana slices, sea salt, cinnamon vanilla, water and milk to a pot and stir to combine,
Heat over medium-high heat for 8-10 minutes or until all the liquid has been absorbed.

Remove oats from heat and stir in the protein powder. If the consistency of the oats gets too thick, add in a little more water or milk. Transfer oats to a bowl and top with additional toppings if you like! 1 serving 10 minutes

recipes.title: RED CURRY CHICKEN
ingredients: 1 Tablespoon extra virgin olive oil, for cooking
directions: at oil in a large frying pan over a medium to high heat. Add in chicken and cook until it is white in colour.

Transfer in all chopped vegetables into the frying pan along with garlic, red curry paste and coconut milk. Turn heat down to a medium heat and simmer for 10minutes or until the vegetables soften in texture.
Microwave rice pouch and distribute among containers or plates and top with red chicken curry. Enjoy! 4 servings 30 minutes

recipes.title: CHICKEN & TOFU PAD SEE EW
ingredients: 2 large zucchinis, cut into half moons
directions: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil. Add noodles and cook According to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a small bowl, combined sauce ingredients together and set aside.

Heat oil in a large walk or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and tofu and cook for 3-4 minutes, continually tossing until browned on all sides. Add the vegetables and cook for a further 3-4 minutes.
Add the noodles and sauce to the pan and stir to combine. Push all ingredients to the side and add eggs, Scramble and then stir through rest of ingredients.
Remove from heat and serve. 4 servings 30 minutes

recipes.title: CHICKEN PASTA BAKE
ingredients: ½ cup shredded cheese Oil spray
directions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Heat a large saucepan over medium–high heat and lightly spray with oil. Cook onion, garlic, carrot and zucchini, stirring, for 5 minutes or until soft. Add mince and cook, stirring to break up lumps, for 5 minutes or until browned.
Stir in tomatoes. Fill the tomato can with water and add to pan. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in pasta and thyme until well combined.
Transfer pasta mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle with mozzarella. Bake for 20-30 minutes or until cheese is golden and pasta is tender. Rest for 5 minutes.
Serve or split into containers. 4 servings 45 minutes

recipes.title: CHOPPED CHICKEN WRAP
ingredients: 4 Cos Heart Lettuce leaves, finely sliced
directions: On a large chopping board, place chicken, lettuce, avocado, onion and cucumber in the middle. Using a large sharp knife, chop in all directions until combined.
In a small bowl, combine cottage cheese, mayonnaise, dill, dijon mustard and salt & pepper. Drizzle over chicken mixture and mix to combine.
Place chopped mixture on to the large wrap and fold together. Serve fresh or toast on a sandwich press. 1 servings 5 minutes

recipes.title: CHICKEN GYROS
ingredients: 1/2 Lebanese cucumber, grated, excess water squeezed
directions: In a large bowl, combine all chicken marinade ingredients with the chicken. Set aside for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare tzatziki by combining all ingredients in a small bowl and mixing to combine. Season to taste.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a medium pan over medium-high heat. Cook chicken, in batches, for 5-10 minutes or until browned. Remove from heat and set aside.
Assemble gyros by adding 1 tablespoon tzatziki, 1/2 cup chicken, salad and feta to a wholemeal pita bread. Optional to toast in a sandwhich press or eat fresh, 4 servings 30 minutes

recipes.title: BANG BANG CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients: 1 hot bbq chicken, skin removed, breast and drumsticks, shredded
directions: Boil water and cook vermicelli noodles per packet instructions. Drain well once noodles are soft.
Combine all sauce ingredients.
In a large salad bowl, combined shredded chicken, vermicelli noodles, coleslaw salad, cucumber, cos lettuce, spring onions, peanuts and stir through sauce.
Serve into plates or containers and top with a sprinkle of black sesame seeds.

recipes.title: QUESADILLAS
ingredients: 1 tablespoon of each, garlic powder & smoked paprika
1 carrot, shaved using peeler or grated
directions: Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium to high heat. Add onion and cook for 2-3 minutes or until translucent and fragrant. Add beef mince and cook, breaking up lumps until all browned. Add garlic powder, paprika and salt and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Lay out wraps flat on a board or plate and lay a flat layer of beef mince across the base.
Top with an even layer of vegetables, spinach and cheese. Top with another wrap and press down gently to flatten.
Heat sandwich press and spray with olive oil.
Transfer quesadillas into the sandwich press to cook until cheese is melted and wraps are golden, about 2 minutes. 4 servings 20 minutes

recipes.title: MONGOLIAN LAMB
directions: In a medium bowl, combine marinade ingredients and lamb, mixing very well. Cover and refrigerate whilst preparing your vegetables.
In a separate bowl, combine all sauce ingredients.
In a large fry pan or wok, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium to high heat. Add onion and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds until starting to colour.
Add remaining vegetables and cook for 5 minutes, or until softened. Add lamb (including marinade sauce) and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until most pieces have turned from red to brown.
Add sauce and simmer, stirring, for 1-2 minutes until thickened.
Serve with rice and top with sesame seeds (if you like)! 4 servings 30 minutes

recipes.title: HOMEMADE BEEF BURGERS
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato, cut into chips
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Combine sweet potato, olive oil and a pinch of salt in a bowl and toss to coat. Transfer to the baking tray and bake for 20-25 minutes or until cooked and crispy.

In a large frying pan over medium heat, add onions and cook for 8-10 minutes or until softened. Add balsamic vinegar and brown sugar and continue cooking for a further 5 minutes or until caramelised and sticky. Remove to a bowl and clean pan.

Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine mince, breadcrumbs, egg, Worcestershire sauce, tomato sauce, salt and pepper. Use your hands to combine well. Divide the mixture into 4 portions, and use form patties.
Return the pan to a medium-high heat and add olive oil. Cook patties for 10–12 minutes, turning once halfway through. Remove to a plate to rest and place slice of cheese on top to melt.
Construct burgers by spreading mustard on base of burger, topping with salad, patty with cheese and pickles. Serve with sweet potato chips. 4 servings 30 minutes

recipes.title: ROAST PUMPKIN & WALNUT SALAD WITH RUMP STEAK
ingredients: 1 tablespoon parsley, finely chopped Pomegranate seeds to
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (fan-forced) and line a baking tray with paper.
Place pumpkin, zucchini, onion and walnuts on the tray. Drizzle with olive oil, maple syrup, salt and pepper and toss to coat. Spread out to ensure there is only 1 layer of vegetables on the tray.
Roast for 30 minutes, or until pumpkin is brown and soft, tossing once at the mid way mark.
Meanwhile, allow steaks to come to room temperature. Drizzle with olive oil and salt & pepper, and rub to ensure the meat is seasoned.

Heat olive oil in a medium fry pan over medium-high heat. Cook steaks, in batches, for 4 minutes on each side and allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing. See not for other steak doneness cooking times.

Remove vegetables from the oven and gently toss using tongs, try to avoid breaking the pumpkin. In a large bowl combine rocket leaves, baked pumpkin mixture and top with feta and parsley. Note: Steak cooking times Rare - 2-3 minutes each side Medium - 4 minutes each side Well done - 5-6 minutes each side 4 servings 35 minutes ROAST PUMPKIN & WALNUT SALAD WITH RUMP STEAK

recipes.title: GRILLED LAMB STEAK WITH ROAST VEG COUS COUS
ingredients: 1 teaspoon each of dried oregano, parsley and basil
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (fan-forced) and line a large tray with baking paper.
Place all vegetables on the tray, add herbs and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Season with salt and pepper and mix, using your hands, to combine. Roast in the oven for 35 minutes.
Meanwhile, put cous cous in a large bowl, pour over the stock and cover, then set aside for 10 minutes, Fluff with a fork once done.

Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a medium pan over medium-high heat. Add lamb steaks to the pan, season with salt and pepper, and cook for 4 minutes on both sides. Set aside to allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
In a small bowl, combine lemon juice, wholegrain mustard, 1 tablespoon olive oil and salt & pepper. Mix through mint leaves.

Add cous cous and salad dressing to a large bowl with the roasted vegetables, and toss gently to combine. Serve with lamb steak and enjoy! 4 servings 45 minutes GRILLED LAMB STEAK WITH ROAST VEG COUS COUS

recipes.title: PRAWN DUMPLING STIR FRY
ingredients: 1 large packet prawn dumplings (Recommend Prawn Gyoza)
1 bunch coriander, chopped Sesame seeds, to serve
directions: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil and cook vermicelli noodles as per packet instructions. Rinse under cold water and drizzle sesame oil over to prevent from sticking. Set aside.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add dumplings, cooking for 2-3 minutes per side, cooking in batches of 6-
Rotate pieces until crisp on all sides. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of oil and add vegetables. Cook, stirring, for 3-5 minutes or until softened. Add noodles and dumplings to the pan.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients until combined.
Add the dressing to pan and combine using tongs to gently toss it all together.
Divide stir fry among bowls or containers.
Sprinkle sesame seeds on top and enjoy! 4 servings 30 minutes

recipes.title: GARLIC PRAWN PIZZA
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red pesto (Recommend: Sundried tomato pesto)
directions: Preheat oven to 180°C (fan-forced) and line a tray with baking paper. Place the wrap on the tray.
In a small bowl, mix together tomato paste and red pesto. Once combined, spread the mixture evenly over the large wrap. Spread half the cheese over the base.
In a small bowl. combine prawns with olive oil and garlic. Mix to coat evenly.
Add prawns, cherry tomato, capsicum and zucchini to the wrap. Top with remaining mozzarella and sprinkle over feta cheese. Optional: Top with a sprinkle of chilli flakes if you like heat.
Bake in the oven for 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese has melted and is golden.
Finish with rocket leaves and cut into 8 slices. 1 serving 25 minutes

recipes.title: CHILLI & LIME BARRAMUNDI WITH ASIAN SLAW
ingredients: Thumb size piece of ginger, minced
1 large red apple, cored, halved and finely sliced
directions: In a small bowl, combine lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, chilli, ginger and garlic, Stir until sugar has dissolved.

Pat barramundi fillets dry with paper towel. Heat olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Place the barramundi in the pan skin side down, and cook for 5 minutes or until the skin is golden and crispy. Turn over and cook for a further 2 minutes or until just cooked through. Transfer to a shallow dish. Once all fillets are cooked, pour over half the chilli lime sauce and allow to sit for 5 minutes (to soak up all the flavours).
Meanwhile, cook vermicelli noodles per packet instructions. Transfer noodles to a large bowl.
Add cabbage, bok choy, apple and mint to the noodles. Pour over remaining chilli and lime sauce and mix gently to combine.

Serve barramundi and asian slaw with additional lime wedges and sesame seeds. Spoon over any remaining sauce on the barramundi once plated. 4 servings 20 minutes CHILLI & LIME BARRAMUNDI WITH ASIAN SLAW

recipes.title: SMOKED SALMON OKONOMIYAKI
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock OR dashi stock (miso)
macros): Bonito flakes Pickled ginger Nori Furikake
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in a large bowl and mix to combine.
Combine eggs and stock in a separate bowl and mix until well combined.
Make a well in the centre of the dry ingredients and pour in the wet mixture. Gently fold together until a batter is formed.
Add cabbage, mushrooms, spring onion and half the smoked salmon into the batter and mix well.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes and whisk together Okonomiyaki sauce ingredients in a separate bowl.

Heat olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Pour all of the batter into the pan. Spread out and ensure in a circular shape and evenly distributed. (Note: You want the heat high enough to create a crisp but not too hot that it burns before setting the batter enough to flip). If available, place the lid on the frying pan and cook for 5-6 minutes on one side. Carefully flip and continue to cook for 3-4 minutes or until golden and cooked through.
Remove to a plate, spread over sauce and remaining smoked salmon.
Top with additional toppings and enjoy! 4 servings 30 minutes

recipes.title: FRITTATA MUG
ingredients: 2 slices of deli ham, thinly sliced
directions: In a large microwave safe mug, gently whisk eggs and cottage cheese using a fork.
Add baby spinach and ham. Stir gently to combine.
Season with salt and pepper.
Place mug in the microwave and cook for 90 seconds. Check the middle of your frittata, if the middle is still runny - add back into the microwave for an additional 30 seconds.
Allow to cool and enjoy!

recipes.title: (untitled)
ingredients: 1/4 avocado, sliced or smashed + 1 hard boiled egg
directions: Prepare rice cakes with chosen topping. Note: Select only 1 topping to ensure that you are sticking within the 200kcal snack recommendation.

recipes.title: HIGH PROTEIN TUNA DIP
ingredients: 4 x Vitawheats 9 seeds and grains biscuits
directions: Mix together all of the ingredients until combined and adjust seasoning, if desired.

recipes.title: YOGHURT BARK
directions: In a medium bowl, add greek yoghurt, honey, vanilla extract and orange zest, and mix to combine.
Line a baking tray with baking paper. Spread the yoghurt mixture onto the baking paper, to a thickness of 8-10mm.
Top the yoghurt with pistachios, hazelnuts, raspberries, and coconut flakes.
Cover the tray with foil and freeze for 2 hours or overnight. When frozen, cut or break into shards.
Store frozen in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: CHOC-PEANUT PROTEIN BALLS
directions: Soak the dates in boiling water for 15 minutes or until soft. Drain dates of excess water.
Blend soaked and drained dates in a food processor until smooth in texture,
Pour into a large mixing bowl with cocoa powder, walnuts, rolled oats, and peanut butter, Mix with hands or wooden spoon until mixture is combined.
Place the mixture into the freezer for 5 minutes or until cooled.
Take mixture out of the freezer once cooled and start to roll into 12 bliss balls on a lined baking tray.
Melt dark chocolate in the microwave in 10-second increments until all pieces are melted. Drizzle chocolate over the bliss balls and place in the fridge to set for an hour.
When the chocolate has hardened, store in an air tight container in the fridge and enjoy as a sweet treat in the afternoons or dessert.

recipes.title: PEANUT BUTTER STUFFED DATES
directions: Slice the top of each date enough so that you can stuff it, but not all the way through the entire date.
Fill each date with ½ teaspoon of peanut butter.
Gently push the sides of the dates together to secure.
Freeze the filled dates for 10-15 minutes.
While the dates are freezing, melt the chocolate. Transfer the chocolate chips to a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 30- second increments and stir in between, until completely melted.
Line a baking tray with baking paper. Dip each date into the chocolate to coat. Transfer to the tray.
Sprinkle with flakey sea salt.
Chill the dates in the fridge for 30 minutes or until the chocolate is set.

recipes.title: RICOTTA TOAST
directions: Spread ricotta on toast. Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon. 1 servings 5 minutes

recipes.title: BANANA BREAD MUG CAKE
ingredients: Optional Additions: >70% dark chocolate, roughly chopped
directions: In a medium bowl, stir together the mashed bananas, maple syrup, egg, and vanilla until combined. Add the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt, Mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into a large microwave-safe mug. Microwave on full power for 2 minutes to 2 minutes 30 seconds (depending on strength of your microwave).
Eat warm with a smear of greek yoghurt and a drizzle of honey. 1 servings 4 minutes

recipes.title: QUICK YOGHURT PARFAIT
directions: In a cup or small bowl, spoon half the yoghurt.
Add a layer of granola and berries.
Repeat with remaining yoghurt and top with extra berries.
Consume immediately. 1 servings 5 minutes
